note: docs/design/FLOOR.md § 11's `fx-intern-walk` (card#12450, card#12451; AT-D3-31): interns ride the elevator and work or rest at their laptops. Every run is fx-snapshot-4's four `aimla` seats over the shipped default map, as fx-elevator's `leave-stale` replays them, with every seat's interns cleared and each run's own stated (`aimla-pm`, with none, is the control on every run); every element carries `activity_state` (D2 § 8.2.1). The deltas' times place each one in a named leg of the arrival it follows; every leg and frame count is re-derived by the test from the scene the run draws. Generated, with the walk measured, by the card's build; regenerate rather than edit.

queue-gain-after-boarding.note: card#12705, review round 1: `aimla-impl-2` loses intern 01 (its walk out waits on the threshold), then gains 10 and 11 and, at 14837 ms, trades 11 for 13 and 14 in one delta. By then intern 01 has left its spot for the cab and its spot is free for a later departure; a re-time from scratch put 01 back at that spot while intern 11's walk out stood on it — one point, two walkers. The walker that has left its spot keeps its timing, so no spot is stood on by two.
